page.content:
Longest early ballad compilation of the outlaw's career.

How A Gest of Robyn Hode connects

  • Topic: Robin Hood — The Gest is the main early narrative of the Robin Hood cycle.
  • Location: Barnsdale — The Gest still places much of Robin's action in Barnsdale.

What is A Gest of Robyn Hode?

A Gest of Robyn Hode (printed c. 1500 from older verse) is the central early text: the poor knight, the sheriff, the king in disguise, and Robin's service and death.

Key threads lead to Robin Hood and Barnsdale.
